_comment: Hand-tuned look and feel for BP_Ship_Vanguard. Applied by Tools/Assets/import_ship.py after the size-based values from the manifest, so everything here wins. Edit, then run the import again (editor closed).

pawn._comment_flight: SC-1a light fighter: thruster accelerations per direction in cm/s^2 (981 = 1 G), SCM / NAV top speeds in cm/s, rotational inertia in deg/s^2. G-Safe and ComStab use the C++ defaults.
pawn._comment_boost: SC-1b. Boost (Shift): manoeuvring thrusters (retro, strafe, up, down) and rotation multiplied, G-Safe suspended. Afterburner (Tab, SCM only): main thrust multiplied, speed limit = SCM x afterburner_speed_multiplier x speed limiter, own fuel tank.
pawn._comment_landing: SC-2a. Gear (N): the Meshy model's skids were fused into the hull; Tools/Blender/build_ai_ship.py cuts them out into SM_Ship_Vanguard_Gear, which rises gear_stow_travel_cm into the hull when stowed (the nose skid hangs 1.1 m under the belly, the main skids 0.55 m). The pads' soles are the bottom of the collision box, so gear_extension_cm is 0. Precision mode (gear down or P): SCM top speed x precision_speed_fraction, turning x precision_turn_scale.

camera_boom._comment: Meshy Vanguard (18. 9. 2026): 14 m long but 11.4 m wide and 6.2 m tall with the gear. Picked from a side-by-side of chase distances (chase_zoom 1.0 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 x 1700 cm): at 1.6x the whole ship sits under the HUD gauges; closer, its nacelles filled the bottom of the screen.

cockpit_camera._comment: Pilot's eye 14 cm above the front edge of the cabin roof (SOCKET_Cockpit in Vanguard_ai_build.json). The model has no interior: from inside the cabin everything is culled (one-sided faces seen from behind), so the eye sits where the old Vanguard's did, at the windscreen. The nose falls away at 29 degrees, beyond the 25 degrees the view shows below the horizon, so looking straight ahead shows no ship; free look (right mouse button) shows it. See Tools/Blender/cockpit_view_survey.py.

materials._comment: Meshy Vanguard: one texture set, re-baked onto the decimated model's own UVs by Tools/Blender/build_ai_ship.py (PBR master M_Ship_PBR), plus the nozzle discs, which the game makes glow with engine load (slot name contains Emissive). The nozzle discs are large, so they glow at 15 instead of the old model's 40 (white-hot while merely hovering).

MI_Ship_Vanguard_Hull._comment: Meshy's paint is very dark navy (base colour ~0.04 linear, the procedural Vanguard's was 0.34) and ~85 % metallic, so in the game it read as a black silhouette (Tools/Shots.ps1 -Preset ship_views, 18. 9. 2026); metallic alone made no visible difference. base_color_tint 2.2 lifts the paint to a dark blue-grey steel, metallic_scale 0.5 keeps some sheen.
